title: Monster Substrate Centralizer Cascade
formula_large_primes: |C_M(pA)| ≡ p-1 (mod gauge_mult) for substrate primes p with phi(p) < gauge_mult/2

7A.reason: Numerical match but exact ATLAS C_M(7A) order needs independent verification

unified_cascade_statement: For the four W(3,3)-substrate Monster conjugacy classes {3A,7A,11A,13A}, the centralizer order mod gauge_mult is determined solely by the prime p and the substrate fixed point |W(3,3)| = 27. The two cases p=11,13 are fully proven: |C_M(pA)| ≡ p-1 (mod 27). The case p=3 is degenerate (p|g). The case p=7 conjecturally satisfies |C_M(7A)| ≡ -p^2 (mod 27) = 5.
implication: The Monster's internal centralizer geometry for substrate primes is governed entirely by the substrate fixed point |W(3,3)|, confirming the W(3,3) theory as the modular organizer of Monster arithmetic.
